game_title: Function Test Arena – Sled Run Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Sled Run, a steep sled run: the innkeeper must handle ice wolves while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Test Arena: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing ice wolves.
theme: Snowy Hold – Sled Run: a steep sled run
core_gameplay_loop: In Sled Run, repeat each round: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing ice wolves. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the tests_passed value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the ice mill using at most 10 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The ice mill reached with actions_used <= 10.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 10 before the ice mill is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Function Test Arena
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tests_passed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice wolves in Sled Run.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The ice mill reached with actions_used <= 10.
